description: 让 Agent 直接读懂并处理任何业务文档。对话上传发票、订单、合同等文件即可完成内容识别、关键信息抽取并输出结构化结果。支持中国 30+ 票据（含验真）、海外多语言发票及 11 种常用证件，覆盖 PDF、图片、Word、Excel、OFD 等格式。

connector.description_en: Let your Agent understand and process any business document directly. Simply upload invoices, purchase orders, contracts, and other files in the chat to identify content, extract key information, and generate structured results. Supports 30+ types of Chinese business documents with authenticity verification, multilingual overseas invoices, and 11 commonly used identity documents across PDF, image, Word, Excel, OFD, and other formats.
